description: Kenya - Geolocalized Power Facilities is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Kenya Power (World Bank Group). Installed and Effective Capacities (MW) per Power Facilities 2014. Data complied from the Kenya Power annual report 2014 (Data submitted on 30.06.2014); the Kenyan Energy Regulatory Commission and Wikipedia for some geolocalizations. Citation: Negawatt challenge. A curated list of datasets for the World Bank Negawatt Challenge competition in Accra and Nairobi cities. Coverage: Kenya. It has 3 files in GeoJSON, CSV, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
